notes.title: Here's the translation of the update points for the game's full version release
notes.content: [p]Since the game launched, ​​we've received a lot of feedback and positive reviews from everyone – first off, a huge thank you for all your support!​​[/p][p]Of course, ​​there were also some issues​​, and ​​the development team takes this very seriously​​. ​​We've actively worked on resolving these.​​[/p][p]Now, ​​we've released a major update to the complete version of the game! We hope it offers a much improved gaming experience![/p]

notes.title: Here's the translation of the update points for the game's full version release:
notes.content:
1.
4 game modes running smoothly

2.
All text content fully translated

3.
All known bugs fixed

4.
Numerous scenes completely remade

5.
Optimized issues like character running glitches
